title: User management
description: Manage user identities, group access, concurrency and balances.
usernameHelp: Use an email address (up to 254 characters), or a 2–32 character username starting with a letter and containing only letters, numbers, dots, underscores and hyphens.
concurrencyHelp: Maximum concurrent requests for this user. 0 = unlimited.
rpmHelp: Maximum requests per minute shared across all API keys for this user. 0 = unlimited; the current group's RPM limit also applies.
subtractHelp: Deducts from this user's balance. The amount cannot exceed the user's available balance.
subtractReturnsHelp: Deducted funds return to the shared balance. The amount cannot exceed the user's available balance.
deleteHelp: The user's sessions and keys will be invalidated. Past transactions and usage records are retained.
grantHelp: Select the groups this user can access. The user follows each group's default permissions and limits.
noGroups: No groups yet. Create one on the Groups page first.
selectedGroups: {{count}} groups selected. With none selected, the user has no group access through these grants.
selectedGroups_one: {{count}} group selected. With none selected, the user has no group access through these grants.
selectedGroups_other: {{count}} groups selected. With none selected, the user has no group access through these grants.
groupsFailed: Groups could not be loaded. User access cannot be edited: {{message}}
sharedWalletHelp: Administrators in this domain share this balance. Funding any administrator credits the same wallet.
resourcePermissionsHelp: Controls what this administrator can see and do in Virtual machines, Codex accounts and the Supplier account pool. Higher levels include View.
resourcePermissionsReadHelp: Lists, details, usage and quota; credentials show status only.
resourcePermissionsCreateHelp: Create virtual machines; create or import Codex accounts.
resourcePermissionsEditHelp: Change settings, groups and scheduling; test, refresh quota; reauthorize or replace credentials.
resourcePermissionsManageHelp: Delete or archive, rebuild, change supplier ownership, terminal, exports and plaintext credentials.
companyHelp: Leave blank to use your company.
